role: positive finite constant: integral of (1-cos y) alpha y^(-alpha-1) over (0,infinity), 0<alpha<2
notes: Local to the power-tail theorem and its annex proof; Durrett names no constant here (v5 book p. 152).

role: probability law on the real line with characteristic function exp(-I_alpha |t|^alpha)
notes: Local name for the weak limit of S_n/n^(1/alpha); not normal for 0<alpha<2.

role: weight of an atomic law at the nonnegative integer k
notes: Feller V.(5.4) notation (vol. 2, 2nd ed., p. 149); local to the atomic symmetrization theorem and its annex proof.

role: weight of each of the points +n and -n under the symmetrized atomic law
notes: Feller V.(5.4) notation; distinct from q_n of def:p15-feller-normalizers and from q_>(t), q_>=(t) of thm:p15-feller-largest-term-inequality, which are separately scoped.

role: modified Bessel function of order p>-1, a real function of a real variable, I_p(x)=sum_k (x/2)^(2k+p)/(k! Gamma(k+p+1))
notes: Feller II.(7.1) (vol. 2, 2nd ed., p. 58); used only at integer order n in V.(5.5). Distinct from the constant I_alpha of thm:p15-w02c-p15-015-power-tail-limit.
